lines.zh: 我踩着半空走，脚下没声。
lines.en: I walk on the edge of the air without a sound.

lines.zh: 这次的对手，值得我认真走。
lines.en: This opponent deserves my full attention.
I step carefully, testing the ground.
The wind pushes and I go with it.

lines.zh: 我边走边把气收成一线。
lines.en: As I walk I gather my ki into a line.
The dust can't keep up behind me.

lines.zh: 我绕过你的房子，怕踩坏。
lines.en: I walk around your house so I don't break it.
Not fast, but every step is sure.
My shadow slides over the rooftops.

lines.zh: 我停了一下，再迈下一步。
lines.en: I pause, then take the next step.

lines.zh: 身上还有旧伤，走得慢些。
lines.en: Old wounds. I walk a little slower.

lines.zh: 这双脚，走过的路太长了。
lines.en: These feet have walked a very long road.

lines.zh: 我抱着胳膊，看远处的山。
lines.en: Arms folded, I look at the far mountains.
I run through my techniques in my head.
My breathing slows and my ki settles.
Someone's close by. I know.

lines.zh: 我把手贴在腰上，收着力。
lines.en: I rest a hand at my waist, holding power in.
Saying nothing is fine too.
I sit cross-legged and wait.
My body is like a bow at full draw.
I'm working out how long this fight will take.
There's iron in the wind's smell.
I lift my eyes to the sky.

lines.zh: 筋还在跳，说明还没到位。
lines.en: My sinews still twitch. Not there yet.
I close my eyes and rest for a breath.
Someone's coming. Time to get up.

lines.zh: 你的气我记住了，别换了。
lines.en: I've learned your ki. Don't change it.

lines.zh: 你不是第一次站在我面前。
lines.en: This isn't your first time facing me.

lines.zh: 我看看你的手，就知道你怕。
lines.en: One look at your hands and I see the fear.

lines.zh: 你的站位，是防守的架势。
lines.en: Your footing is a defensive one.

lines.zh: 我给你一次机会，先出手。
lines.en: I'll give you one chance. Swing first.

lines.zh: 我笑得很轻，你听见了吗？
lines.en: I laughed very softly. Did you hear?
Your ki is still rising. That's good.
In this fight I won't move first.

lines.zh: 你身上没有杀气，我放心了。
lines.en: No killing intent in you. I'm relieved.
Hold still. Don't turn your back.
If you really mean to fight, don't hold back.

lines.zh: 我见过太多这样的眼神。
lines.en: I've seen that look too many times.
If you have something to say, say it.
I nod. Consider it accepted.

lines.zh: 别从我左边来，我习惯守左。
lines.en: Not from my left. I guard the left.

lines.zh: 我这一身伤，都是这么来的。
lines.en: Every scar on me came from moments like this.
You still have time to change your mind.
One more step and we've started.
That one woke me up.
I bite down and nail my feet in place.

lines.zh: 我用拇指擦掉嘴角的血
lines.en: I wipe the blood from my mouth with my thumb.
Not bad. Again.
I breathe out the stale air.
The wound burns, and I'm smiling.

lines.zh: 我的气没散，别高兴太早。
lines.en: My ki hasn't scattered. Don't celebrate yet.
That one was vicious.
I brace my shoulder and straighten up.

lines.zh: 疼，但还不到倒下的时候。
lines.en: It hurts, but it's not time to fall.
After the fight I'll eat. I promise.
I'll remember this bowl of noodles.
I sit and fill my stomach first.
You made this? Not bad.
Hold on, I'm not done eating.
A full stomach means ki for fighting.
Bowl in hand, I actually smile.
I'll take the whole table.
Anything left in the pot?
A fed man strikes true.
You hit me like hitting a bell.
I put a hand out and steady you.
My ki surged and threw you back.
Sorry, I wasn't watching where I went.
That should have left your palms red.
Shoulder to shoulder, neither gave ground.
I held back, and it was still too much.

lines.zh: 你比我矮一头，撞不着脸。
lines.en: You're a head shorter; you can't reach my face.
I turn and let you go first.
Don't crowd; there's room enough.

lines.zh: 我答应过一个人，要回去。
lines.en: I promised someone I'd come back.

lines.zh: 这比任何一场战斗都难。
lines.en: This is harder than any fight.

lines.zh: 我把手放在胸口，慢慢说。
lines.en: I put a hand to my chest and speak slowly.
Someone at home is waiting for dinner.
I'm not good at this sort of thing.
Some words took me years to learn.
When she laughs, I finally relax.

lines.zh: 我把手伸过去，她握住了。
lines.en: I reach out, and she takes my hand.

lines.zh: 这一趟回去，我不再走了。
lines.en: When I go home this time, I'll stay.
I lower my head and can't manage a second sentence.
I bend down, pick it up, and dust it off.
This might be useful. I'll keep it.
I swallow it whole without chewing.
You dropped this. I'll hold it for you.
I weigh it. Not heavy.
Tucked away. Don't lose it.
A little food to tide me over.
I tuck it into my belt.
More on the ground; I'll take those too.
Done. I clap the dirt off my hands.
His ki suddenly went still.

lines.zh: 我看见了，就在石堆后面。
lines.en: I see him, behind the stones.

lines.zh: 他把气藏起来了，藏得不好。
lines.en: He's hiding his ki, and badly.

lines.zh: 我抬头，锁定了那个位置。
lines.en: I look up and fix on that spot.
I know this ki.
He's about to move; his shoulder went first.
I unfold my arms and set my stance.
There's no avoiding this one.

lines.zh: 我先让一步，看他的意思。
lines.en: I'll give a step and see what he wants.

lines.zh: 他选了这条路，我成全他。
lines.en: He chose this road. I'll oblige him.
My ki begins to climb.
From here I have range.
I count. One, two…
He's moved. Then we begin.
The Kamehameha is charging.
Easy. Let him come.
I've read the pattern of his punches.
I step back to give him room.

lines.zh: 他每一次呼吸，我都跟着。
lines.en: I follow every breath he takes.

lines.zh: 这一招，我见过一模一样的。
lines.en: I've seen this exact technique before.
I turn half away and shed his force.
He's fast, so I don't race him.
I watch his knees.
His footing is getting light.
Two more moves and he'll be open.
I raise my palm and gather a breath of ki.

lines.zh: 他绕到我身后，我早就转了。
lines.en: He circles behind me; I've already turned.
I let his fist graze past.
He's gambling on one strike. I won't.

lines.zh: 我的耐心，比他的力气长。
lines.en: My patience outlasts his strength.
He retreats; I don't chase far.
I'll save this ki for the end.
I can see he's afraid.
All right. Then it ends here.
My punch goes in and he blocks.
In the air I land three kicks.
Super God Fist, and only half power.
That punch grazed his ear.
My landing is louder than the punch.

lines.zh: 他挡得住第一下，挡不住第二。
lines.en: He stops the first, not the second.
In close: elbow, knee, palm.
After it lands I withdraw at once.

lines.zh: 他的血溅在我的护腕上。
lines.en: His blood spatters my wristband.
I stop, and he's already on one knee.
Once more, and I double it.
For that one I used ki.
His backhand catches my ribs.
I ride the force up into the treetops.
The wind of my fist strips the leaves.
Enough. Stop.

lines.zh: 我落在土上，脚陷了半寸。
lines.en: I land and my feet sink half an inch.

lines.zh: 这里的重力，比我想的轻。
lines.en: Gravity here is lighter than I expected.
I raise my head and get my bearings.
A few kis, not far off.

lines.zh: 我把手插进袖子，先看看。
lines.en: I tuck my hands in my sleeves and look around.
The wind blows the dust aside.

lines.zh: 这地方安静，不像有强敌。
lines.en: Quiet here. Doesn't feel like a strong enemy.
My wounds aren't fully healed.

lines.zh: 站定之后，我才呼出一口气。
lines.en: Only once I'm set do I let out a breath.
No moon above, only stars.

lines.zh: 我落下来，脚下的草压平了。
lines.en: I land, and the grass flattens under me.
There's still dust on my clothes.

lines.zh: 我先走一圈，看看这世界。
lines.en: I'll take a walk and see this world.
Someone's approaching. Light footsteps.
This trip may not be a bad thing.
I touch the old scar at my waist.

lines.zh: 站在这儿，我就能感觉到。
lines.en: Standing here, I can already feel it.
Let me show you my opening stance.

lines.zh: 火苗卷上袖子，我甩了两下。
lines.en: Flame catches my sleeve and I shake it out.

lines.zh: 我从高处摔下，砸进土里。
lines.en: I fall from above and drive into the earth.

lines.zh: 水底我闭着气，眼前发白。
lines.en: Underwater I hold my breath until my sight whitens.

lines.zh: 气浪把我掀翻，我又站起来。
lines.en: The blast flips me and I get back up.
Something sharp is lodged in my leg.

lines.zh: 一道光缠住我，气被压住了。
lines.en: Light binds me and my ki is smothered.
I'm so hungry I can't close my fist.

lines.zh: 雷落到我身上，我咬着牙受了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes me and I take it through my teeth.

lines.zh: 脚下是空的，我抓着风往下坠。
lines.en: Nothing below; I fall, clutching at the air.
